defect.cause: entry point guards compared import.meta.url with argv[1] without resolving symlinks; Node resolves the main module's symlink, so a command reached through the installer's current link ran nothing and exited 0
defect.observedEffect: every service.js action (identity, status, start, ready, stop, released) printed nothing and exited 0 through current/dist/preview/service.js; scripts behaved the same
defect.correction: one invokedDirectly helper in preview/state.ts compares the realpath of argv[1] with the realpath of the module; cli.ts, service.ts and every script entry point use it

coverage.E1: standard test runs service.js identity/status and pin-scenario.js through a current symlink and through the real path with equal results; it first failed on 5421768 with empty output and exit 0 through the symlink
coverage.E1-install: installer journey runs service.js identity through <prefix>/current after a real local installation
coverage.E2: no guard compares pathToFileURL(argv[1]) any more

limits: node_modules is outside the content proof.
Cross-process I3 recovery uses a controlled service adapter with a real H2 fixture.
Resume of operations created by fa8e1b5 or earlier requires the original executor and is not qualified.
Tag v0.3.2 remains published without a release; its service entry point does not run through the installer's current symlink.
The real installation, configuration alignment, launcher pin, real service cycle through current and canonical public publish/resume follow this commit and are recorded in the release assets.
